Campaigns

Who lurks in the shadows?

Pick a race and role, or leave them on Any, then summon. Each NPC comes with a voice, a want, a secret and a stat block suggestion.

Saved creatures appear in that campaign's encounter “Add enemy” list. Villains are also added to its NPCs.

What waits at the end of the road?

Forge a villain with a full stat block, scheme, lieutenants and final-battle plan, or a custom monster with lore, tactics and loot. Leave options on Random and Challenge on Auto for a creature balanced for your party.

Your current character stays put when you switch tabs. Press “Save to My characters” on its sheet to move it to the My Characters tab, where you can keep editing it.

Open My Characters

A hero steps from the dark

Leave anything on Random, or lock in a race, class and level. You get a full 5e sheet: scores, HP, AC, saves, skills, attacks, spell slots, features, gear and a backstory hook.
